name: jevsight
description: Speculative tool execution for Claude Code. Jev predicts your agent's next shell command or MCP call and Jevsight runs it early when the odds say it pays. Wrap any stdio MCP server with bin/mcp_proxy.py.

api_key.title: Jev API key
api_key.description: OpenRouter or TypeSafe API key used for Jev predictions

provider.title: Jev provider
provider.description: vercel, openrouter or typesafe (default: whichever key is set)

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow (predict and log only), on (run guesses early), or off

alpha.title: Waste price
alpha.description: How much a wasted worker-second costs relative to a saved second. Lower means more speculation.

extra_commands.title: Extra safe commands
extra_commands.description: Command prefixes that are safe to run early, such as npm test. Your Bash allow rules are used too.
